README.md: You control the PuntersEdge credits. The top of every page shows the credits left, and nothing is
spent until you tap:
| Button | Credits | What it does |
| **Load card** / **Reload card** | about 2 + 3 per race (~32 for ten races) | Field, scratchings, recent runs, then prices |
| **Refresh prices** | 2 | Every bookmaker's price for the whole card, then new picks |

<details class="explain"><summary>How the picks and figures work</summary>
Most likely is the runner with the highest chance of winning, and the one
with the highest chance of placing, whatever their price. Value picks are made only when
a price beats the runner's chance by enough, so many races have none. Each way counts as landed
when the runner placed.
Confidence comes from the most likely winner's chance: High at 40% or
more, Medium at 30% to 40%, Low under 30%. On races the model was not fitted on, High picks won
about half the time, Medium about a third and Low about a quarter.
Per $1 is profit or loss per dollar staked at the prices shown. Saved races use
starting prices, with place prices estimated from them (the place market's measured 40% margin
included); exotic dividends were not saved. Those races were also used to fit the model, which
flatters them a little: races from Derby Day on are the clean test.
